title: Dan Britt - Orbits and Ice Ages: The History of Climate
summary: Dan Britt lectures on the history of climate, covering orbital cycles, ice ages and conditions millions of years ago. It frames current climate debate with deep-time context.
why: Strongly recommended as a clear explanation of 50-60 million years of climate history that clears up confusion.

quote.text: For anyone interested in finding out more about the last 50-60 million years of climate history I would strongly recommend this talk
